reference.configuration: Svetlana as designed in 1913: long forecastle, three funnels, two tripod masts and fifteen single 130 mm guns in deck and casemate positions. This source-specific original profile shows only the visible broadside, with far-side guns obscured naturally. The Soviet 1930s twin-AA mounts, altered torpedo outfit and radar are excluded.
reference.note: Stylized class interpretation guided by catalog dimensions, armament and the linked recognition reference; not an engineering plan or exact reconstruction. Continuous hull/deck surfaces, shaped housings and round fittings are original polygon interpretations of the same documented stations.
